# MediVault Pro - Free MCCQE1 Question Bank

MediVault Pro is a comprehensive, free medical examination preparation platform specifically designed for International Medical Graduates (IMGs) preparing for the Medical Council of Canada Qualifying Examination Part I (MCCQE1).

## Core Resources
- **Q-Bank:** Over 6,000 exam-style multiple-choice questions with detailed rationales.
- **High-Yield Notes:** Structured clinical summaries covering all major medical specialties.
- **Clinical Decision-Making (CDM):** Interactive cases focused on clinical reasoning.
- **Visual Mnemonics:** Memory aids and clinical tricks for efficient study.
